visual_review: Wide uneven Ork cleaver with jagged back, oily nailed leather grip and open squared butt loop. Belly carries curved growing teeth with largest at tip, two pale roots emerge through back, one missing near-grip tooth replaced by a bent iron bolt visibly wired into its gap. Dirty ochre daubs and worn metal, no gore, jaw, skull, chainsaw or scene. Socket, tooth mounts and bolt wiring physically coherent. Unique review candidate only.
